recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reopen only if PA/Gender Harmony wants a new example story or different example values; FHIR-19672 itself needs no further current-source work.
issue_request: FHIR-19672 was an Applied/Persuasive PA issue requesting a Patient example for patient sex and gender. Its final resolution noted the example had been added under FHIR-29673 and narrowed the remaining work to adding an additional recorded sex from the driver's license.
initial_application: The FHIR-29673 Gender Harmony branch added source/patient/patient-example-sex-and-gender.xml and registered it in list-Patient-examples.xml. Commit 581cffcacba3a964e2b7d018cdf4f7cce4a875d6 then explicitly updated the example per FHIR-19672 by adding the driver's-license recordedSexOrGender block.
additional_context: Patient is active in source/fhir.ini and the example is included in source/patient/list-Patient-examples.xml. PA minutes record the persuasive vote, the Sex and Gender planning page ties FHIR-19672 to FHIR-29673, and the Gender Harmony Zulip thread confirms the example intentionally distinguishes SAAB, Driver's License, and Insurance Card RSG entries.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the applied request; no FHIR core source edit was necessary.
